notes: MediaPipe metrics are computed on sampled frames.

strengths: Maintained perfect eye contact with the camera throughout the entire presentation.
The speaker's face and body were consistently visible and centered in the frame.
Demonstrated a stable on-screen presence without distracting movements.
improvements: Posture was identified as a major weakness, suggesting a closed or slumped position.
Hand gestures were used infrequently and were not visible for a majority of the video.
The overall confidence level was moderate and could be projected more strongly.
The vertical, low-resolution video format can appear unprofessional.
recommendations: Practice presenting with an upright posture, keeping shoulders back and chest open to project authority.
Ensure your hands are visible and use purposeful gestures to emphasize key messages.
Record in a horizontal (landscape) orientation and at a higher resolution for a better viewing experience.
Rehearse the material thoroughly to build self-assurance, which will improve perceived confidence.
gemini_analysis.summary: Excellent eye contact was a key strength, but overall impact was diminished by poor posture and limited hand gestures. Improving physical presence and confidence is crucial for a stronger delivery.
